recognize_zh: 這是一張皮膚臨床照片，有毛髮的皮膚上可見多處不規則、線狀到斑片狀的紫斑與點狀出血（purpura/ecchymoses），沒有隆起；在類澱粉沉積症（amyloidosis）合併後天性第十因子缺乏時，皮膚出血是線索之一，但照片本身不具特異性。
features: Multiple irregular, flat, red-purple purpuric macules with linear and streaky configuration
Scattered pinpoint petechiae at the periphery
No palpable/elevated lesions, ulceration or necrosis evident
describe_en: Clinical photograph of hair-bearing skin shows multiple flat, irregular red-purple purpuric macules and ecchymoses with a streaky, linear arrangement and scattered petechiae. The lesions do not appear raised or necrotic. In systemic AL amyloidosis, cutaneous bleeding results from vascular fragility due to amyloid infiltration of vessel walls and can be aggravated by acquired factor X deficiency from adsorption of factor X onto amyloid fibrils. The photograph is not diagnostic by itself; confirmation requires tissue Congo red staining, a prolonged PT and aPTT with low factor X activity, and a monoclonal protein work-up.

ddx.vs: Senile purpura occurs on sun-damaged forearms of elderly patients with normal coagulation studies, whereas amyloid-associated bleeding may show prolonged PT/aPTT from low factor X and periorbital 'pinch' purpura.
ITP purpura is accompanied by a markedly low platelet count with normal PT/aPTT.
Vasculitic lesions are typically palpable purpura on dependent areas, with neutrophilic small-vessel vasculitis on biopsy rather than Congo red-positive vessel walls.
